senses.gloss:
ऋध् ऋध्, i. 4, Par., ii. 5, Par. and ved. also i. 6 and ii. 7.
 1. To [] prosper, Man. 9, 322 (ii. 5); MBh. 2, 1693 (i. 4); pass. To prosper, MBh. 3, 8488.
 2. To augment (ved.).
 3. † To please; ऋउअन, Prosperous, Ragh. 2, 50.
 --With सम् सम्, To prosper, Man. 9, 315 (ii. 5), MBh. 2, 1960 (i. 4); सम्-ऋद्ध.
 1. Completed, Rām. 1, 44, 60.
 2. Abundant, Rām. 2, 104, 26.
 3. Abounding in (with instr. or abl.), Daśak. in Chr. 184, 14; Man. 3, 6.
 4. Wealthy, Daśak. in Chr. 185, 15.
 --Cf. ἄλθω; also ἀλδαίνω, etc., and ὀρόδαμνος; but ऋध् being compounded, viz. ऋ-धा, and the Vedas having a vb. ऋद्, which may be considered also as derived from ऋ, the base ἀλδ or ὀροδ may be another derivation from ऋ; cf. also Lat. ordior.
